sources.fullCitation: “Du bist der Mann, der den Frauen gefällt” / “Ich suche einen, der mir allein gehört.” Excerpt from Ein toller Einfall (1932), attributed by the uploader to Willy Fritsch, Ellen Schwanneke and Rosy Barsony; music credited to Walter Jurmann and Bronislaw Kaper. YouTube video, 3:04, published by Alparfan, 2015-03-20.

sources.researchNote: The upload identifies Ein toller Einfall (1932) and names the passages “Du bist der Mann, der den Frauen gefällt” and “Ich suche einen, der mir allein gehört”, together with Willy Fritsch, Ellen Schwanneke and Rosy Barsony. The excerpt documents the answering title form retained for the existing song record; the uploader’s two passage titles do not by themselves establish two separate compositions. works.publicNote: Two gendered counterparts of the song are documented. Ufaton-Verlag published it, and Hofmeisters Monatsbericht registered it, as “Ich suche Eine, die mir allein gehört”, the form sung in the film by Willy Fritsch. The surviving film excerpt preserves the answering form used as the title here, sung by Ellen Schwanneke and Rosy Bársony; no disc of it is recorded in the discographic title lists.
